next_action: Merged into main at c2a93a8; capture what settled, then bee close --feature paseo-cli-autodetect.

route.rationale: One resolver home gains env and daemon-pid discovery; config still wins

cells.title: Find the paseo CLI of the running daemon without config
cells.action: Per decision 03ff4564, in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding/paseo.rs change paseo_command(cfg) (line 76): return herding.paseo.command (or the legacy top-level paseo.command) when set and non-blank; else the PASEO_CLI env value when it names an existing file; else the running daemon's CLI: read <paseo home>/paseo.pid (JSON, key pid; home from crate::herding::paseo_state::home_from with an empty command, PASEO_HOME, HOME), then the PASEO_CLI entry of /proc/<pid>/environ when it names an existing file, else <parent of /proc/<pid>/exe>/resources/bin/paseo when that file exists; else "paseo". Put the discovery in a pure helper that takes the env value, the paseo home and a proc root path, so tests drive it with a tempdir. Under cfg(test), paseo_command must not read the real process env or the real /proc (follow the TEST_PASEO_HOME thread_local pattern in paseo_state.rs), so paseo_command_reads_config_and_defaults_to_paseo still passes inside a Paseo agent. Tests red first: config wins over env; env wins over daemon; daemon environ PASEO_CLI; daemon exe-dir fallback; a missing or garbage pid file falls through to paseo; an env value naming a missing file is skipped. In docs/knowledge/areas/bee-herding/the-paseo-channel.md replace 'The key `herding.paseo.command` sets the CLI executable name. The default command is `paseo`.' with the new order, citing decision 03ff4564. Write no code comments.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --bin bee herding::paseo

truths: with no config, bee uses PASEO_CLI when it names an existing file
with no config and no PASEO_CLI, bee uses the CLI of the daemon named in paseo.pid
with nothing found, the command is plain paseo
prohibitions: no change to any paseo_command call site
tests never read the real /proc or the real PASEO_CLI env
